item_name: Rothco Hook & Loop U.S. Flag Low Profile Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco's Hook & Loop US Flag Low Profile Cap offers a versatile and customizable option for any occasion. The cap features an embroidered US flag on a 3.5 inch x 2 inch loop field, allowing you to easily add and change your favorite morale patches. Made from 100% brushed cotton twill, this cap ensures all-day comfort and durability. The interior sweatband keeps your head dry and cool, even in hot weather. An adjustable hook & loop back closure provides a secure fit for most adult head sizes.
